page: Microsoft Azure DC32ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. The instance features 32 vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores on an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor using x86_64 architecture, with two threads per core under a dedicated CPU allocation model. The processor cache architecture comprises 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity is provisioned at 128.0 GB, maintaining a standard general-purpose ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage includes 1288 GB of local SSD space, and the instance is capable of attaching Premium Storage. No discrete GPUs are provisioned with this model.

Hardware instruction features include support for AVX, AVX-512 (f, vnni, and bf16 extensions), alongside dedicated cryptographic sets such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. In standardized benchmarking, the system displays strong single-core CPU throughput, placing in the top 25% of stress-ng tests with a score of 3024.37, as well as top-tier PassMark encryption performance scoring 35286.08. Multi-core performance aligns within the middle 50% across Geekbench (15260.0) and PassMark CPU tests (44663.57). In-memory caching tests measure 38.57 million Redis SET operations per second, while PassMark database operations yield a median score of 14252.35.

From a cost efficiency standpoint, bundling 1288 GB of local SSD storage directly into the instance reduces the necessity of purchasing separate block storage for high-throughput scratch data, local indexing, or temporary database tables. The balanced core-to-memory architecture avoids underutilization in mid-tier enterprise workloads. The DC32ads_v6 is well suited for enterprise application backends, relational databases, continuous integration build and compilation pipelines, and cryptographic workloads requiring AVX-512 and VAES acceleration.
description: The Microsoft Azure DC32ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor offering 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores on an x86_64 architecture. The system provides 128.0 GB of memory and includes 1288 GB of local SSD storage with Premium Storage support, operating without discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the top 25% for single-core stress-ng performance and PassMark encryption, supported by hardware-level AES, VAES, and AVX-512 vector instructions. Multi-threaded evaluations such as Geekbench multi-core and general database operations position the instance in the middle 50% performance bracket. The inclusion of direct local SSD storage offers qualitative cost efficiency for temporary or caching workloads. The DC32ads_v6 is suitable for relational database engines, compilation tasks, web application tiers, and encrypted data pipelines.
